_comment: The career menu offers the names rF2 has actually reported in your results,
merged with the drivers we hold records for. Neither of those can contain a
name you invented — so this file exists, and it is yours to edit.
Add a line, restart, and the name is in the picker. That is the whole
THESE NAMES GET NO RECORD AND NO HISTORY, and that is deliberate rather
than unfinished. `drivers.json` holds real people with checkable records; a
name typed in here has none, and inventing one would be the single thing
this product refuses to do. What it DOES get is everything the overlay
watches: race a season under it and the booth will say how many wins it has
this year, because it counted them.
Names appear in the picker in the order they are listed here, ABOVE the
generated ones — it is your list, so it goes first.
